latestVersion.changelog:
Add Music to Video Online — Merge Music and Export Video, version 1.0.0

- Initial public release of the skill.
- Upload video and audio clips, specify edit instructions, and receive a 1080p rendered video in ~20–40 seconds.
- No need for timeline editing or export settings; describe your edits in plain language.
- Uses cloud GPU nodes for fast, server-side merging and export.
- Supports major video, audio, and image formats up to 500MB.
- Robust handling for authentication, free credits, error cases, and session state.
